name: IV Drip Rate Calculator
description: Calculates IV fluid flow rates in mL/hr and drops per minute (gtt/min).

formulas.label: Flow Rate
formulas.explanation: Total volume divided by total time in hours.

formulas.label: Drop Rate
formulas.explanation: Calculates drops per minute based on total volume, drop factor, and total time converted to minutes.

sections.title: Nursing Safety Considerations
sections.content: IV administration requires continuous monitoring to ensure patient safety and therapeutic efficacy.
bullets: Verify the correct fluid, volume, and rate against the provider's order.
Verify the drop factor on the IV tubing package before calculating gtt/min.
Inspect the IV insertion site for signs of infiltration, phlebitis, or infection before and during infusion.
Monitor the patient for indications of fluid volume overload, particularly in pediatric, geriatric, and cardiac/renal patients.
Use an electronic infusion pump instead of a manual gravity drip for all high-alert medications and precise titrations.
Verify calculations independently or with a second nurse when required by facility policy.

disclaimer: This tool is for educational and simulation purposes only. Do not use for clinical decision-making without independent verification and adherence to institutional policies.
